Senior Software Engineering Lead
Acme Insurance Group - Omaha, NE (Hybrid)

About the role
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineering Lead to drive modernization of our policy administration platform. You will lead a team of engineers building cloud-native services used by thousands of internal users and agents.

What you'll do
- Lead and mentor a team of 5-8 software engineers
- Design and build microservices using C#, .NET, and Node.js on AWS
- Champion CI/CD, automated testing, and infrastructure as code with Terraform
- Partner with product owners and business stakeholders to shape the roadmap
- Modernize legacy systems and guide cloud migration efforts
- Drive agile ceremonies including sprint planning and retrospectives

Requirements
- 5+ years of professional software development experience with C#, .NET, or Java
- Experience with AWS services such as Lambda, S3, and EC2
- Strong knowledge of SQL Server and PostgreSQL
- Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes
- Experience building REST APIs and event-driven architecture with Kafka
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
- Proven leadership and mentoring experience

Nice to have
- Insurance or financial services domain experience
- Python scripting experience
- AWS Certified Solutions Architect certification
- Experience with Power BI or Tableau reporting
